executiveSummary:
• The tests captured a total of 182 API calls across various workflows. 
• Multiple refresh calls were observed, with one endpoint being called 28 times in a single test. 
• A significant performance issue was noted with the simsfinance.home endpoint, showing a latency of 5498ms. 
• User actions were directly linked to specific API calls, indicating a clear UI to API relationship. 
• These patterns may suggest areas for performance improvement and optimization in user workflows.
